start.welcome:
👋 Hi, {name}!

I'll create images for you from text descriptions using AI. Just describe what to draw.

🎨 Tap «Create» to start.
start.help: PromptArt — AI media generator & editor Commands: /start — main menu /token — your Pollinations key (generation needs it) /edit — combine / edit your photos /prompts — prompts builder, templates, and library /settings — model and style settings /history — recent generations /favorites — saved favorites /balance — pollen balance and prices /help — this help Getting started: 1. Send your Pollinations key: /token YOUR_KEY (create one at https://enter.pollinations.ai). Generations bill your own balance. 2. Use reply buttons or send text to generate images, videos, audio (TTS), or chat with AI. 3. Configure specific settings for each modality in settings. Powered by Pollinations.ai

balance.help_permission: 💰 To show your pollen balance here, your key needs the profile usage permission. How to get one: 1. Go to enter.pollinations.ai 2. Open the Keys page 3. Create a key with permissions profile + usage 4. Send it to the bot: /token YOUR_KEY Until then, check your balance at enter.pollinations.ai.

token.required: 🔑 Your own Pollinations key is required The bot generates on your account, never on someone else's balance — so nothing runs without a key. 1️⃣ Tap the button below and create a key 2️⃣ Send it here: /token YOUR_KEY The message with the key is deleted immediately. Remove the key later with /token delete.
token.status_none: 🔑 No Pollinations key set — generation is unavailable. Create a key with the button below and send: /token YOUR_KEY
token.status_set: 🔑 Key set: {masked} Replace with /token NEW_KEY, remove with /token delete
token.saved: ✅ Key saved: {masked} Generations now bill your own Pollinations balance.
token.invalid: ❌ Pollinations rejected this key (401). Check that you copied it in full and that it is not revoked, then send it again: /token YOUR_KEY
token.deleted: 🗑 Key removed. Generation stays off until you send a new one.
start.welcome_no_key: 👋 Hi, {name}! I generate images, video and speech from a description, edit photos and can chat — all with AI. ⚠️ First you need your own Pollinations key. This bot runs on your account, never on someone else's balance, so nothing generates without it. Two steps: 1️⃣ Tap the button below and create a key 2️⃣ Send it here in one message: /token YOUR_KEY I delete the message with the key right away so it does not stay in the chat.
start.menu_hint: 👇 The menu is below the input field. Buttons start working once you send a key.
token.malformed: ❌ That does not look like a key. A Pollinations key is a string of latin letters and digits with no spaces. Copy the whole key from the Pollinations page and send: /token YOUR_KEY
